reading_source: Every page-1 number checked against its place value and reviewed Japanese number reading. Explicit 300 さんびゃく, 600 ろっぴゃく, 800 はっぴゃく, 3000 さんぜん, 8000 はっせん; long vowels preserved. Prefer よん/なな/きゅう for general numbers; separate し/しち/く variants are labelled contextual. Composite 1234/12345 reviewed digit by digit. Sentence topic は in 番号は → わ. Speech inputs stay distinct from display kanji. Page 2: all 31 calendar-day readings checked against Japan Foundation Irodori date chart https://nd.jpf.go.jp/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/X_L12_NP.pdf and vocabulary index https://www.irodori.jpf.go.jp/assets/data/wordlist_X.pdf. Explicit ついたち, よっか, ようか, とおか, じゅうよっか, はつか, にじゅうよっか; 17/27 use しち and 19/29 use く. Five examples reviewed: 四月八日 → しがつようか, topic は → わ. Lexical は in はつか retained. 何日 → なんにち, 日付 → ひづけ. No pauses split a date or precede a particle. Page 3: month names and relative month/year readings checked against Japan Foundation Marugoto Starter Wordbook https://marugoto.jpf.go.jp/assets/docs/download/starter_a/MarugotoStarterWordbook_KH.pdf and Irodori https://www.irodori.jpf.go.jp/assets/data/starter/pdf/X_L12.pdf. Year endings: 4 よねん, 7 しちねん (ななねん also used), 9 きゅうねん. Sentence topic は → わ; lexical は preserved in はちがつ. No internal pauses in dates or years; comma after complete 来月 phrase. Page 4: weekday and day expressions checked against Japan Foundation Irodori Starter vocabulary https://www.irodori.jpf.go.jp/assets/data/wordlist_X.pdf and exact kanjium word/readings. Conversational おととい/きのう/きょう/あした/あさって selected. 市場 means food market here → いちば, not しじょう. Sentence topic は → わ; なにする natural casual question. Pause after complete 明日 phrase only, never before particles. Page 5: exact hours/minutes checked against Japan Foundation Irodori Starter vocabulary pages 27–28 and 44–45. 4時 よじ, 7時 しちじ, 9時 くじ; minutes いっぷん/さんぷん/よんぷん/ろっぷん/はっぷん/じゅっぷん. Alternative readings labelled. Compound times reviewed by hour and minute components. Sentence は → わ, lexical はん preserved; no pauses inside time phrases or before particles. 45分 has multiple accentual components and remains provisional as a whole. Page 6: every duration 1–10 and question reading checked against Japan Foundation duration chart https://www.kyozai.jpf.go.jp/kyozai/material/BTS00009/ja/render.do. Half-year and duration readings cross-checked with Irodori. 1日 いちにち vs date ついたち; 4時間 よじかん, 9時間 くじかん; 1/8/10 weeks geminated; 1/6/8/10 months geminated. Contextual object を → お and topic は → わ reviewed separately. No pauses before particles or inside durations. Page 7: counting people 1–10 checked against Japan Foundation https://www.kyozai.jpf.go.jp/kyozai/material/KML00038/ja/render.do and counter chart BTS00010. Explicit ひとり/ふたり/よにん; 7 uses ななにん. Larger numbers reviewed as number + にん, with final 4 よにん. Sentence 今日は → きょうわ, lexical ひとり preserved. No internal pauses or breaks before で. Page 8: all 〜つ and 〜個 readings 1–10 and questions checked against Japan Foundation counter chart https://www.kyozai.jpf.go.jp/kyozai/material/BTS00010/ja/render.do. 十 とお, いっこ/ろっこ/はっこ/じゅっこ; 11個 じゅういっこ and 20個 にじゅっこ reviewed by components. Sentence を → お and topic は → わ checked individually. No pauses before particles or inside counts. Page 9: 本 and 杯 1–10 plus questions checked against Japan Foundation counter chart https://www.kyozai.jpf.go.jp/kyozai/material/BTS00010/ja/render.do. Explicit sound changes いっぽん/さんぼん/ろっぽん/はっぽん/じゅっぽん and いっぱい/さんばい/ろっぱい/はっぱい/じゅっぱい; questions なんぼん/なんばい. 一杯 noun/counter accent selected, not adverb homophone. Sample particles を → お, は → わ reviewed individually; lexical はい retained. Long vowels in きゅうり/びーる/こーひー preserved. Page 10: all 枚/冊/台 1–10 and questions checked against Japan Foundation counter chart BTS00010 https://www.kyozai.jpf.go.jp/kyozai/material/BTS00010/ja/render.do. Explicit いっさつ/はっさつ/じゅっさつ; 枚 and 台 no consonant changes. Sample readings checked including おさら, ようい, りょうり, じてんしゃ and のーと. Object を → お, topic は → わ reviewed individually. No pauses before particles or inside counts. Page 11: age readings checked against Japan Foundation Irodori Lesson 4 https://nd.jpf.go.jp/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/X_L04_NP.pdf and counter chart BTS00010. Explicit いっさい/はっさい/じゅっさい, 4歳 よんさい, 20歳 はたち or にじゅっさい. Composite ages checked by tens and final digit. Sentence topic は → わ; lexical は in はたち and はっさい preserved. Commas follow complete time phrases, never immediately before particles. Page 12: 回 and 番 counts 1–10 and questions checked against Japan Foundation counter chart https://www.kyozai.jpf.go.jp/kyozai/material/BTS00010/ja/render.do. Explicit いっかい/ろっかい/はっかい/じゅっかい. Ordinal 目 め; 回目 occurrences versus 番目 positions. Sentence readings reviewed: いって/いった doubled consonants, contextual を → お and は → わ; comma only after complete frequency phrase 一週間に二回. Page 13: yen 1–10 and price questions checked against Japan Foundation BTS00010 counter chart. 4円 よえん; hundreds 300 さんびゃく, 600 ろっぴゃく, 800 はっぴゃく; thousands 3000 さんぜん and 8000 はっせん retained before えん. Composite prices checked by place value. Lexical はち preserved; sentence topic は → わ reviewed individually. Prices remain connected without internal pauses. Page 14: 匹 and 階 1–10 and questions checked against Japan Foundation BTS00010 counter chart. Explicit animal p/b changes; floor 3 さんがい and question なんがい. Floor lookup keys use trailing punctuation to remain distinct from occurrence 回 recordings and their accents; display readings unchanged. Sample lexical かっています for 飼っています checked; particles を → お and は → わ reviewed individually. No internal count pauses. Page 15 cooking: each reading checked for culinary sense: 一人前 いちにんまえ and 二人前 ににんまえ; 一皿/二皿 ひとさら/ふたさら; 一切れ/二切れ/三切れ ひときれ/ふたきれ/みきれ. 大さじ おおさじ, 小さじ こさじ, 合 ごう. Measurement context checked against https://www.kikkoman.co.jp/homecook/basic/measure/tools.html. Exact dictionary matches used for available whole words. Recipe sentence lexical long vowels and object を → お checked individually; no pauses before particles or inside measures. Additional cooking references: https://laits.utexas.edu/japanese/joshu/counters/counters_category.php for 切れ and https://www.kikkoman.co.jp/homecook/basic/measure/drop_of_salt.html for 少々.
